what: New unclosed-fence test asserts against the prior section-aware fixture variable instead of the new fixture directory
scenario_or_breakage: If implemented literally, the test either fails by grepping the old $DDED/plan.txt or fails to prove the new $TMP/unclosed-fence/plan.txt fixture preserved duplicate Constraints bullets
suggested_fix: Define a new fixture variable such as DUNCLOSED="$TMP/unclosed-fence", set DESIGN_TMPDIR to it, and assert grep -c for the actual duplicate bullet in "$DUNCLOSED/plan.txt"
